capabilities: Sync card notes to Anki incrementally via AnkiConnect
Create cards from built-in and user-defined templates
Convert $…$ and $$…$$ math to Anki's LaTeX syntax
Track study time and bounded sessions in a dashboard
Tag removed cards as orphans instead of deleting them
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README discloses that the plugin only contacts AnkiConnect on the local machine, sends no telemetry, and writes to the vault only to insert ID markers into card blocks.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to author flashcards in notes and review them in Anki without manually managing card files and IDs.

relations.evidence: Desktop Anki with the AnkiConnect add-on. Syncing is desktop-only
Compatible with Obsidian_to_Anki files. The same START/END block syntax and <!--ID: …--> markers

summary: Flashcard authoring plugin that writes cards in notes and syncs them to Anki over AnkiConnect, with templates, math conversion, and a study dashboard.
